description: This is a continuation of MA2108 Mathematical Analysis I. The objective of this course is to develop rigorously all the basic results in one- and multi-variable calculus. The emphasis is on logical rigour. Major topics: total and partial derivatives, Jacobian matrix, differentiable functions, chain rule, mean value theorem, l’Hopital’s rule, Taylor’s theorem, convergence of derivatives; Riemann and Darboux integrals, Fubini’s theorem, convergence of integrals, improper integral of functions, fundamental theorem of calculus, integration by parts, differentiation under integral sign, change of variable formula.
prerequisite: If undertaking an Undergraduate Degree THEN (( must have completed 1 of MA2101/MA2101S at a grade of at least D) AND ( must have completed 1 of MA2108/MA2108S at a grade of at least D))
prerequisiteRule: PROGRAM_TYPES IF_IN Undergraduate Degree THEN ((COURSES (1) MA2101:D, MA2101S:D) AND (COURSES (1) MA2108:D, MA2108S:D))
